# Amedisys Home Health Care Services

Home Health Care

Skilled nursing and therapy to help you recover from illness, injury or surgery, or to manage
long-term conditions.

[Start Support ][107]

Hospice Care

Physical, emotional and spiritual care at the end of life, along with help for loved ones.

[Find Comfort ][108]

Palliative Care

Relief from pain and symptoms to help improve quality of life at any stage of a serious illness.

[Find Relief ][109]

Hospital-Level and Skilled Nursing Care at Home

Contessa, an Amedisys company, enables a new standard of care with provider partners and payors.

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the

  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to
  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.
  
  [ Explore ][51]
  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

## The Visiting Angels Approach

For over 25 years, Visiting Angels has been dedicated to providing compassionate and life-changing
in-home care, offering comfort, peace of mind, and “hope at home” for families across the nation.
Discover how we can help your loved one thrive in the place they cherish most—home.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Senior Home Care

What Services Do Visiting Angels Provide?

Visiting Angels offers non-medical [home care services][59] tailored to help seniors age safely and
comfortably at home. Our core services include, but are not limited to:
* **[Companion Care][60]:** Help with meal preparation, light housekeeping, and errands
* **[Personal Care:][61]** Assistance with bathing, dressing, grooming, and toileting
* **Specialized Care:** Dedicated support for Alzheimer’s, Dementia, palliative care, and
  end-of-life care
* **[Transition to Home Care][62]:** Helping seniors safely return home after a surgery or hospital
  stay
* **[Respite Care][63]:** Temporary relief for family caregivers

We offer flexible scheduling, from a few hours per week up to 24-hour or live-in care.

What Is the Difference Between Non-Medical Home Care and Home Health Care?

While “non-medical home care” and “home health care” sound similar, they are actually two distinct
services that are commonly confused. The main difference is the type of support provided and the
medical necessity behind it.

Home health care is clinical in nature, typically prescribed by a physician to treat a specific
medical condition or to help a patient recover from surgery, through services such as wound care and
physical therapy.

In contrast, non-medical home care—like the services provided by Visiting Angels—focuses on
assisting seniors with essential activities of daily living, such as meal preparation, mobility
assistance, and personal care, and more. Our devoted caregivers provide the consistent and
compassionate support seniors need to live safely and independently in their own homes.

How Much Does In-Home Care Cost?

The [cost of in-home care][64] varies and is tailored to your specific situation. Key factors that
influence professional home care costs include the level of care needed, frequency and duration of
visits, geographical location, and type of support required.

With Visiting Angels, you pay only for the help you actually need—whether a few hours a week or
[full-time home care support][65]—giving you a more affordable, flexible alternative to an assisted
living facility.

We also provide a free in-home consultation to assess your needs and provide a customized quote
tailored to your budget and care requirements.

How Do I Get Started With a Free Home Care Consultation?

Our free, no-obligation [in-home care consultation][66] provides expert guidance and answers your
care questions, helping you navigate the decision-making process with peace of mind and zero
pressure. An in-home consultation is a way for us to get to know your family and understand your
specific needs to create a care plan that feels right for your loved one.

[Get started with in-home care][67] by contacting your Visiting Angels [local home care agency][68]
to schedule a consultation at your loved one’s home.

If you’re a [long-distance caregiver][69], we will conduct a one-on-one in-home consultation with
your loved one and a detailed phone consultation with you.

Does Medicare or Insurance Cover In-Home Care Services?

Typically, Medicare and standard health insurance do not cover non-medical assistance with
activities of daily living that Visiting Angels primarily provides. However, you may find coverage
through the following:
* **Long-Term Care Insurance:** The most common form of private coverage for home care
* [**Veterans Benefits**][70]**:** Programs like Aid and Attendance can often be used for these
  services
* **Medicare Advantage (Part C):** Some private plans offer limited supplemental home care benefits
* **Medicaid:** May cover costs for those who meet specific financial and medical eligibility
  requirements

Because every policy is different, we recommend a [free consultation][71] to help you identify which
benefits apply to your situation.

How Quickly Can Home Care Services Start?

We understand that needs and situations can change quickly, so we strive to begin care as soon as
possible. While each Visiting Angels location is different, caregivers can typically start providing
services within 48 hours of your initial consultation. In some urgent situations, we may be able to
coordinate same-day support to ensure your loved one has the care they need right away.

Do You Provide Care in Assisted Living Facilities or Nursing Homes?

Yes, while Visiting Angels primarily serves seniors in their own homes, we can provide [supplemental
care to seniors residing in nursing homes][72] or assisted living facilities. Often, facility staff
members are stretched thin across many residents, and our presence can help your loved one receive
the dedicated, continuous attention they deserve.

Whether they need extra assistance with mobility, specialized memory support, or simply the comfort
of a consistent companion, we work alongside the facility's team to enhance your loved one's quality
of life.

Is Visiting Angels Available 24/7, Including Holidays?

Our experienced caregivers are committed to enhancing the quality of life for your senior and
providing peace of mind for you and your family. We’ll create a customized care plan to help your
loved one age safely and contently in their own home—with one-on-one support from a [caregiver][40]
you both can trust.

Discover how Visiting Angels can offer personalized and compassionate care services today.

options can help foster comfort and safety and enhance quality of life at home.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Senior Home Care

What Services Do Visiting Angels Provide?

Visiting Angels offers non-medical [home care services][59] tailored to help seniors age safely and
comfortably at home. Our core services include, but are not limited to:
* **[Companion Care][60]:** Help with meal preparation, light housekeeping, and errands
* **[Personal Care:][61]** Assistance with bathing, dressing, grooming, and toileting
* **Specialized Care:** Dedicated support for Alzheimer’s, Dementia, palliative care, and
  end-of-life care
* **[Transition to Home Care][62]:** Helping seniors safely return home after a surgery or hospital
  stay
* **[Respite Care][63]:** Temporary relief for family caregivers

We offer flexible scheduling, from a few hours per week up to 24-hour or live-in care.

What Is the Difference Between Non-Medical Home Care and Home Health Care?

While “non-medical home care” and “home health care” sound similar, they are actually two distinct
services that are commonly confused. The main difference is the type of support provided and the
medical necessity behind it.

Home health care is clinical in nature, typically prescribed by a physician to treat a specific
medical condition or to help a patient recover from surgery, through services such as wound care and
physical therapy.

In contrast, non-medical home care—like the services provided by Visiting Angels—focuses on
assisting seniors with essential activities of daily living, such as meal preparation, mobility
assistance, and personal care, and more. Our devoted caregivers provide the consistent and
compassionate support seniors need to live safely and independently in their own homes.

How Much Does In-Home Care Cost?

The [cost of in-home care][64] varies and is tailored to your specific situation. Key factors that
influence professional home care costs include the level of care needed, frequency and duration of
visits, geographical location, and type of support required.

With Visiting Angels, you pay only for the help you actually need—whether a few hours a week or
[full-time home care support][65]—giving you a more affordable, flexible alternative to an assisted
living facility.

We also provide a free in-home consultation to assess your needs and provide a customized quote
tailored to your budget and care requirements.

How Do I Get Started With a Free Home Care Consultation?

Our free, no-obligation [in-home care consultation][66] provides expert guidance and answers your
care questions, helping you navigate the decision-making process with peace of mind and zero
pressure. An in-home consultation is a way for us to get to know your family and understand your
specific needs to create a care plan that feels right for your loved one.

[Get started with in-home care][67] by contacting your Visiting Angels [local home care agency][68]
to schedule a consultation at your loved one’s home.

If you’re a [long-distance caregiver][69], we will conduct a one-on-one in-home consultation with
your loved one and a detailed phone consultation with you.

Does Medicare or Insurance Cover In-Home Care Services?

Typically, Medicare and standard health insurance do not cover non-medical assistance with
activities of daily living that Visiting Angels primarily provides. However, you may find coverage
through the following:
* **Long-Term Care Insurance:** The most common form of private coverage for home care
* [**Veterans Benefits**][70]**:** Programs like Aid and Attendance can often be used for these
  services
* **Medicare Advantage (Part C):** Some private plans offer limited supplemental home care benefits
* **Medicaid:** May cover costs for those who meet specific financial and medical eligibility
  requirements

Because every policy is different, we recommend a [free consultation][71] to help you identify which
benefits apply to your situation.

How Quickly Can Home Care Services Start?

We understand that needs and situations can change quickly, so we strive to begin care as soon as
possible. While each Visiting Angels location is different, caregivers can typically start providing
services within 48 hours of your initial consultation. In some urgent situations, we may be able to
coordinate same-day support to ensure your loved one has the care they need right away.

Do You Provide Care in Assisted Living Facilities or Nursing Homes?

Yes, while Visiting Angels primarily serves seniors in their own homes, we can provide [supplemental
care to seniors residing in nursing homes][72] or assisted living facilities. Often, facility staff
members are stretched thin across many residents, and our presence can help your loved one receive
the dedicated, continuous attention they deserve.

Whether they need extra assistance with mobility, specialized memory support, or simply the comfort
of a consistent companion, we work alongside the facility's team to enhance your loved one's quality
of life.

Is Visiting Angels Available 24/7, Including Holidays?

In contrast, non-medical home care—like the services provided by Visiting Angels—focuses on

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## Next Generation Healthcare**

Solutions for a healthier future -
Our mission is to make access to quality healthcare easier,
giving you peace of mind and confidence in tomorrow.

## **Why choose us as your trusted international health insurer?**

### **#1**

#### **Best in class experiences**

Financially strong company with A+ Superior, A.M. Best rating. Number 1 insurance brand by
Interbrand for the seventh year running.

### **2M+**

#### **Worldwide expertise**

Growing network of over 2 million quality medical providers, settling medical bills directly with
the provider for most in-patient treatments.

### **24/7**

#### **Support**

Always on: 24/7 multilingual Helpline and Emergency Assistance Services.

### **48hrs**

## **Wellness Hubs**

At Allianz, we believe in empowering you to lead a life of balance and vitality. That's why we're

support. Whether you're looking to enhance your mental wellbeing, prioritise women's health, cancer

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

Get answers to your questions quickly and easily with our handy FAQs.

[ Read the full FAQs ][131]

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

[homepage banner image - with elders]
anvayaa has been a true blessing, giving us peace of mind with their reliable elder care support
right at our doorstep.

### Google Rating

### Languages Care

### Operational Since

### Emergencies Handled

## A True One-Stop Solution For Elder Care

For families and working professionals who worry about their elderly loved ones, anvayaa presents a
full circle of care that protects and empowers elders. How? It’s simple. By providing personalised
support, consistent proactive engagement, and using predictive technology, which helps elders regain
their independence and gives you the peace of mind you deserve.

[Discover Our Services][52]

## Companionship That Feels Like Family

Our care companions bring more than just help; they bring heart. They listen like a curious child,
share interesting stories over tea, accompany walks to the park, and even celebrate the birthdays of
your elderly loved ones. Why? Because real care isn’t just about doctor visits and medicine
delivery. It’s about providing companionship – just like a real family.
[Know More][53]
[For Real 24/7 Protection]

## Help Arrives Before You Call

During a crisis, most elder care programs wait for a call before acting. But with our proactive,
proudly patented solutions, like wearable watches and ratan pendant, help arrives even when you
can’t call for it. Here’s how it works: our safety solutions monitor health vitals 24/7. If an
anomaly is detected, an instant alert goes to our care team for immediate action.
[Know More][54]

## Family Care Benefits For Employees

Many employees juggle their careers while worrying about the wellbeing of their elders. This
constant concern diverts their focus from work. That’s where our anvayaa Nishchint Solution comes
in; it empowers employers to help their employees balance both work and family wellbeing. The
result? Peace of mind, increased productivity, and better employee retention.
[Know More][55]
[Family Care Benefits For Employees]
[For Real 24/7 Protection]

## Holistic Dementia Care at Home

Backed by Gen AI and LLM-based technology, our dementia family caregiver app provides personalized
cognitive exercises tailored to your elderly loved one’s profile to help slow the progression of
dementia at home. What’s more, you can easily book appointments with health specialists such as:
psychologists, neurologists, or even ask for a few days of respite care by our care specialist –
directly through the app.
[Know More][56]

## Where Tech Meets Heart

We design technology with one simple goal: to solve problems for our elders, not create new ones.
That’s why our tech is grandparent-proof: easy enough for even the most tech-shy granny to use, yet
smart enough to anticipate medical needs before the family even asks.
[Know More][57]
[Where Tech Meets Heart]
[For Real 24/7 Protection]

## Insurance Made Easy for You

Insurance should be simple, supportive, and stress-free. As an IRDAI-approved insurance provider,
that’s exactly what we aim at anvayaa. Whether it’s personal accidents, health, home, travel, cyber,
or fire insurance – our consultants are here to help you find the right coverage as per your needs.
[Know More][58]

your friendly care buddy!

She’s the human face of our values and what we stand for

**Dignity**
**Empathy**
**Patience**
**Transparency**
**Honesty**

Anvi found her calling. Not in machines or codes, but in people, in care that listens, in dignity
that empowers, In trust that comforts. She doesn’t just extend her arms. She’s completes our circle
of care.

### Emergencies Handled

## A True One-Stop Solution For Elder Care

For families and working professionals who worry about their elderly loved ones, anvayaa presents a
full circle of care that protects and empowers elders. How? It’s simple. By providing personalised
support, consistent proactive engagement, and using predictive technology, which helps elders regain
their independence and gives you the peace of mind you deserve.

[Discover Our Services][52]

## Companionship That Feels Like Family

Our care companions bring more than just help; they bring heart. They listen like a curious child,
share interesting stories over tea, accompany walks to the park, and even celebrate the birthdays of
your elderly loved ones. Why? Because real care isn’t just about doctor visits and medicine
delivery. It’s about providing companionship – just like a real family.
[Know More][53]
[For Real 24/7 Protection]

## Help Arrives Before You Call

During a crisis, most elder care programs wait for a call before acting. But with our proactive,
proudly patented solutions, like wearable watches and ratan pendant, help arrives even when you
can’t call for it. Here’s how it works: our safety solutions monitor health vitals 24/7. If an
anomaly is detected, an instant alert goes to our care team for immediate action.
[Know More][54]

## Family Care Benefits For Employees

Many employees juggle their careers while worrying about the wellbeing of their elders. This
constant concern diverts their focus from work. That’s where our anvayaa Nishchint Solution comes
in; it empowers employers to help their employees balance both work and family wellbeing. The
result? Peace of mind, increased productivity, and better employee retention.
[Know More][55]
[Family Care Benefits For Employees]
[For Real 24/7 Protection]

## Holistic Dementia Care at Home

Backed by Gen AI and LLM-based technology, our dementia family caregiver app provides personalized
cognitive exercises tailored to your elderly loved one’s profile to help slow the progression of
dementia at home. What’s more, you can easily book appointments with health specialists such as:
psychologists, neurologists, or even ask for a few days of respite care by our care specialist –
directly through the app.
[Know More][56]

## Where Tech Meets Heart

We design technology with one simple goal: to solve problems for our elders, not create new ones.
That’s why our tech is grandparent-proof: easy enough for even the most tech-shy granny to use, yet
smart enough to anticipate medical needs before the family even asks.
[Know More][57]
[Where Tech Meets Heart]
[For Real 24/7 Protection]

## Insurance Made Easy for You

Insurance should be simple, supportive, and stress-free. As an IRDAI-approved insurance provider,
that’s exactly what we aim at anvayaa. Whether it’s personal accidents, health, home, travel, cyber,
or fire insurance – our consultants are here to help you find the right coverage as per your needs.

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Frequently asked questions

[ Who are the therapists? ][17]
Every therapist providing services on BetterHelp is a qualified and experienced counselor,
psychologist, social worker, or therapist. They must also have a relevant academic degree, at least
3 years of experience, and have credentials from their professional organization. This includes
completing the necessary education, exams, training, and practice requirements. We refer to
therapists across our sites and apps according to their professional title and credentials, as
recognized in the jurisdiction responsible for their profession.
[ Who will be helping me? ][18]
After you sign up, we will match you to an available therapist who fits your objectives,
preferences, and the type of issues you are dealing with. If you feel your therapist isn't a good
fit for you, you may elect to be matched to a different therapist.
[ Is BetterHelp right for me? ][19]
BetterHelp may be right for you if you're looking to improve the quality of your life. Whenever
there is anything that interferes with your happiness or prevents you from achieving your goals, we
may be able to help. We also have therapists who specialize in specific issues such as stress,
anxiety, relationships, parenting, depression, addictions, eating, sleeping, trauma, anger, family
conflicts, LGBT matters, grief, religion, self esteem, and more.

BetterHelp is **not** the right solution for you if any of the following is true:
* You are a minor or you are under the care of a legal guardian
* You are in an urgent crisis or an emergency situation
* You were required to undergo therapy either by a court order or by any other authority
* You do not have a device that can connect to the Internet or you do not have a reliable Internet
  connection
[ How much does it cost? ][20]
The cost of therapy through BetterHelp ranges from $70 to $100 per week (billed every 4 weeks), and
it is based on your location, source, preferences, and therapist availability. You can cancel your
membership at any time, for any reason.
[ I signed up. How long until I'm matched with a therapist? ][21]
The matching process can take a few hours or a few days, depending on therapist availability.
[ How will I communicate with my therapist? ][22]
You can get therapy in four ways:
* **Exchanging messages** with your therapist
* **Chatting live** with your therapist
* **Speaking over the phone** with your therapist
* **Video conferencing** with your therapist
You can use different ways at different times as you wish, based on your needs, availability, and
convenience.
[ Can BetterHelp substitute for traditional face-to-face therapy? ][23]
The professionals who work through BetterHelp are registered therapists who hold the proper
credentials to provide therapy. However, while the service may have similar benefits, it's not
capable of substituting for traditional face-to-face therapy in every case. Please note that your
therapist won't be able to make any official diagnosis, to fulfill any court order or prescribe
medication.
[ How long can I use BetterHelp? ][24]
This depends on your needs and varies a lot from one person to another. Some people feel they get
most of the value after just a few weeks, while others prefer to stick to the program for an
extended period of time. This is completely up to you.
[More frequently asked questions][25] [Get started][26]

## Frequently asked questions

[ Who are the therapists? ][17]
Every therapist providing services on BetterHelp is a qualified and experienced counselor,
psychologist, social worker, or therapist. They must also have a relevant academic degree, at least
3 years of experience, and have credentials from their professional organization. This includes
completing the necessary education, exams, training, and practice requirements. We refer to
therapists across our sites and apps according to their professional title and credentials, as
recognized in the jurisdiction responsible for their profession.
[ Who will be helping me? ][18]
After you sign up, we will match you to an available therapist who fits your objectives,
preferences, and the type of issues you are dealing with. If you feel your therapist isn't a good
fit for you, you may elect to be matched to a different therapist.
[ Is BetterHelp right for me? ][19]
BetterHelp may be right for you if you're looking to improve the quality of your life. Whenever
there is anything that interferes with your happiness or prevents you from achieving your goals, we
may be able to help. We also have therapists who specialize in specific issues such as stress,
anxiety, relationships, parenting, depression, addictions, eating, sleeping, trauma, anger, family
conflicts, LGBT matters, grief, religion, self esteem, and more.

BetterHelp is **not** the right solution for you if any of the following is true:
* You are a minor or you are under the care of a legal guardian
* You are in an urgent crisis or an emergency situation
* You were required to undergo therapy either by a court order or by any other authority
* You do not have a device that can connect to the Internet or you do not have a reliable Internet
  connection
[ How much does it cost? ][20]
The cost of therapy through BetterHelp ranges from $70 to $100 per week (billed every 4 weeks), and
it is based on your location, source, preferences, and therapist availability. You can cancel your
membership at any time, for any reason.
[ I signed up. How long until I'm matched with a therapist? ][21]
The matching process can take a few hours or a few days, depending on therapist availability.
[ How will I communicate with my therapist? ][22]
You can get therapy in four ways:
* **Exchanging messages** with your therapist
* **Chatting live** with your therapist
* **Speaking over the phone** with your therapist
* **Video conferencing** with your therapist
You can use different ways at different times as you wish, based on your needs, availability, and
convenience.
[ Can BetterHelp substitute for traditional face-to-face therapy? ][23]
The professionals who work through BetterHelp are registered therapists who hold the proper
credentials to provide therapy. However, while the service may have similar benefits, it's not
capable of substituting for traditional face-to-face therapy in every case. Please note that your
therapist won't be able to make any official diagnosis, to fulfill any court order or prescribe
medication.
[ How long can I use BetterHelp? ][24]
This depends on your needs and varies a lot from one person to another. Some people feel they get
most of the value after just a few weeks, while others prefer to stick to the program for an
extended period of time. This is completely up to you.

## HOME HEALTHCARE

## REVOLUTIONISING

[Become a carer ][18]
[Get in touch ][19]

## Revolutionising healthcare – taking it from hospital to home

Cera is Europe's largest provider of digital-first home healthcare. We are redefining healthcare by
moving more and more services out of hospitals and into people's own homes.

[SofiaYangMartinezPhotography-26.jpg]

## Cera is leading the use of AI to predict health risks, cutting hospitalisations by more than half

Our carers and nurses deliver a visit every second on average, using‎ Cera's technology to keep
people safe and well in their‎ own homes. 

## Our technology reduces service user falls by 20% – the leading cause of hospitalisations in older
## people

Cera is transforming health outcomes on a historic scale while easing pressures on public services –
saving £1 billion to date for the UK Government & NHS and contributing £1.5 million in daily
savings.

[SofiaYangMartinezPhotography-253.jpg]

## We are using AI to transform staffing in care – attracting 1 million frontline applicants in 2
## years

We are growing the care talent pool – using AI to revolutionise recruitment, training, retention and
productivity, and making care more of a career through our industry-leading Career Pathways.

## We are boosting the economy by creating thousands of jobs in care

Our nationwide Back to Work programme is creating thousands of jobs for the long-term unemployed,
with 34% of recent Cera recruits previously unemployed, 16% joining us from longer-term economic
inactivity, and double the industry average living with a disability.

[Mark Allen COOPER00001.jpg]

## Our model is 15 times more carbon-friendly than hospital care

We are reducing the environmental impact of care by embedding carbon-efficiency into our operations
and reducing avoidable hospital admissions – contributing to a greener healthcare future.

## Cera is innovating to take care into the future

Cera has scaled 100x in five years, growing our annualised revenues from $5m to $500 million, and we
are pioneering the use of innovative technologies including AI Care Robots to lead the sector into
the future.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Elderly Care Services

What range of elderly care services do you provide?

Our elderly care services cover a comprehensive range of needs, including personal care, medication
management, meal preparation, mobility assistance, companionship, household help, and coordination
of medical appointments. We tailor these services to each individual’s specific requirements and
preferences.

How do you assess the care needs of elderly clients?

We conduct a thorough initial assessment that evaluates physical, emotional, and social needs. This
includes reviewing medical history, observing daily routines, and discussing preferences with the
client and family members. Based on this comprehensive assessment, we create a personalized care
plan.

Can your elderly care services be adjusted as needs change?

Absolutely. We understand that care needs can evolve over time, so we regularly review and adjust
our care plans. Our team maintains open communication with clients and families to ensure we’re
always meeting current needs and preferences.

Our care specialists are highly qualified professionals with certifications in elderly care. They
undergo continuous training in areas such as dementia care, fall prevention, and first aid. We also
ensure all our staff have extensive experience in working with seniors and are selected for their
compassion and dedication.

How do you promote independence in elderly clients?

We focus on enabling rather than doing for. Our caregivers encourage clients to participate in daily
activities as much as they’re able, providing support only where needed. We also introduce adaptive
techniques and equipment that can help maintain independence and confidence.

FasterCapital is a global venture builder and online incubator dedicated to co-funding and
co-founding innovative startups. Established in 2014, we are now #1 venture builder in terms of
number of startups that we have helped, money invested and money raised. We have supported over 1620
startups in raising more than $2.8 billion, while directly investing over 1 billion in 1145
companies. Our comprehensive support system includes a worldwide network of [mentors][166],
[investors][167], and [strategic partners][168], allowing us to transform ideas into scalable,
market-ready businesses.

## About me

I am an applied microeconomist working at the intersection of labour, public, and health economics.
Starting Autumn 2026, I will be Associate Professor of Economics at the University of Oxford,
jointly appointed with [Balliol College][11]. I am currently a Senior Research Fellow in the
[Department of Economics][12], Oxford, and affiliated with [Lady Margaret Hall][13], [Nuffield
College][14], [CEPR][15], and [IZA][16]. I direct the [Centre for Research on Outreach and
Access][17] (CROA) and co-direct the [Centre for Quantitative Diversity Studies][18] (with [Barbara
Petrongolo][19]).

My research agenda has two strands. First, I study the parent–child relationship across three
phases: the effects of childbirth, intergenerational dynamics across the life course, and the
consequences when the relationship ends at parental death. Second, I examine how policy, labour
market dynamics, and education contribute to heterogeneous outcomes in modern labour markets and in
well-being more broadly.

I communicate research to broader audiences through policy briefs (e.g., [VoxEU][20]; [IZA World of
Labor][21]) and direct engagement with business and policymakers (e.g., via [Oxford Elevate][22]).
My work has been featured in international media, including the New York Times and The
Observer/Guardian.

Please get in touch on [mathias.jensen@economics.ox.ac.uk][23] if you would like to talk research!

## News

May 2026 – [Effects of Parental Death on Labor Market Outcomes][24] (with Ning Zhang) published in
the [American Economic Review][25].

## Contact

jointly appointed with [Balliol College][11]. I am currently a Senior Research Fellow in the
[Department of Economics][12], Oxford, and affiliated with [Lady Margaret Hall][13], [Nuffield
College][14], [CEPR][15], and [IZA][16]. I direct the [Centre for Research on Outreach and
Access][17] (CROA) and co-direct the [Centre for Quantitative Diversity Studies][18] (with [Barbara
Petrongolo][19]).

My research agenda has two strands. First, I study the parent–child relationship across three
phases: the effects of childbirth, intergenerational dynamics across the life course, and the
consequences when the relationship ends at parental death. Second, I examine how policy, labour
market dynamics, and education contribute to heterogeneous outcomes in modern labour markets and in
well-being more broadly.

I communicate research to broader audiences through policy briefs (e.g., [VoxEU][20]; [IZA World of
Labor][21]) and direct engagement with business and policymakers (e.g., via [Oxford Elevate][22]).
My work has been featured in international media, including the New York Times and The
Observer/Guardian.

Please get in touch on [mathias.jensen@economics.ox.ac.uk][23] if you would like to talk research!

## News

May 2026 – [Effects of Parental Death on Labor Market Outcomes][24] (with Ning Zhang) published in
the [American Economic Review][25].

## All types of plans for all types of people

### [Health insurance plans][13]

Explore a range of individual and family plan options, including ACA Marketplace plans.

### [Medicare plans][14]

Find coverage that goes beyond Original Medicare, including Medicare Advantage plans.

### [Medicaid plans][15]

See Medicaid plan options if you have low income or qualify due to a special circumstance.

### [Dental, vision and supplemental plans][16]

Browse plans that can help you get coverage for medical costs not covered by your medical plan.

## Frequently asked questions about health insurance

### What is health insurance?

Health insurance is a plan, or policy, that covers a percentage of doctors’ visits and hospital
bills. It helps offset the costs of both planned and unplanned medical needs. Medical care can be
expensive, but health insurance may help lessen the financial burden.

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

## Find The Right HomeCaring Service

We deliver in-home aged care and NDIS support to help you feel confident, comfortable and in control
of your life at home.

We focus on delivering high-quality, compassionate support that’s built around your needs, not the
system’s.

Everyone deserves to feel independent and respected in their home. Whether you need a little help or
more complex care, we’re here with the experience, clinical excellence and service to make life
easier.

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### How can HomeCaring benefit me?

HomeCaring has a dedicated team of professionals with skills and experience across the aged care and
disability sectors. We provide services through the NDIS, Support at Home and private arrangements.
We have the flexibility and knowledge to be responsive to your needs at all times. We offer a
complimentary in-home assessment, and can guide you through various ways of receiving support
appropriate for you. From your first point of contact with HomeCaring, you will always speak with a
caring team member who will focus on the best way to meet your needs.

#### Can I switch from my current provider to HomeCaring?

Of course! Get in touch with our team today and they’ll talk you through the process, and how we can
work with you to maximise your support.

#### What services does HomeCaring provide?

Contact us today and we can guide you through the process, whether that’s NDIS or Support at Home.
We can also provide privately paid services when you don’t have any government funding, or while
you’re waiting for approvals.

#### Will my care team be local?

Yes. Your care is led by a local HomeCaring director and team who live and work in your community.
That means they understand your area, speak your language and are close by when you need them.

#### How quickly can I get started?

We understand that when you need support, time matters. Our team will respond promptly, provide a
free in-home assessment and work with you to get your care plan up and running as soon as possible,
often within days.

#### What if I don’t have funding yet?

That’s okay, we can still help. Our team can guide you through the process of applying for NDIS or
Support at Home, and we also offer privately paid services to support you while you wait for
approval.

## Find The Right HomeCaring Service

We deliver in-home aged care and NDIS support to help you feel confident, comfortable and in control
of your life at home.

We focus on delivering high-quality, compassionate support that’s built around your needs, not the
system’s.

Everyone deserves to feel independent and respected in their home. Whether you need a little help or
more complex care, we’re here with the experience, clinical excellence and service to make life
easier.

[Get Started][94]

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### How can HomeCaring benefit me?

HomeCaring has a dedicated team of professionals with skills and experience across the aged care and
disability sectors. We provide services through the NDIS, Support at Home and private arrangements.
We have the flexibility and knowledge to be responsive to your needs at all times. We offer a
complimentary in-home assessment, and can guide you through various ways of receiving support
appropriate for you. From your first point of contact with HomeCaring, you will always speak with a
caring team member who will focus on the best way to meet your needs.

#### Can I switch from my current provider to HomeCaring?

Of course! Get in touch with our team today and they’ll talk you through the process, and how we can
work with you to maximise your support.

#### What services does HomeCaring provide?

Contact us today and we can guide you through the process, whether that’s NDIS or Support at Home.
We can also provide privately paid services when you don’t have any government funding, or while
you’re waiting for approvals.

#### Will my care team be local?

Yes. Your care is led by a local HomeCaring director and team who live and work in your community.
That means they understand your area, speak your language and are close by when you need them.

#### How quickly can I get started?

We understand that when you need support, time matters. Our team will respond promptly, provide a
free in-home assessment and work with you to get your care plan up and running as soon as possible,
often within days.

#### What if I don’t have funding yet?

That’s okay, we can still help. Our team can guide you through the process of applying for NDIS or
Support at Home, and we also offer privately paid services to support you while you wait for
approval.

# Redesigning the
# Aging Journey

Honor Technology is reshaping the future of aging care, leading the way for healthtech innovation,
combined with a human touch. Our brands provide goods and services that equip aging adults to live
on their own terms. Through our advanced proprietary technology and groundbreaking platforms, we’re
not just imagining a better aging journey—**we’re making it a reality**.

[ Join Us ][10]
[1_hero_hexagons_homepage.webp]

## Age on your own terms

Since 1994, our global home care brand, [**Home Instead**][11], has been providing aging adults the
quality care they need to age in the comfort of their own homes. Now, powered by Honor Technology,
Home Instead is redesigning the aging journey with innovative solutions and compassionate,
personalized care. We’re committed to ensuring that more aging adults can live at home, with
independence, dignity, and the support they deserve.

### **10k**

#### Americans turn 65 every day

### **90%**

#### of them want to age at home

### **1.5+ bil**

#### people will be over age 65 by 2050

### **1+ mil**

#### hours of care served per week

[2_mission_dancing_woman_hexagon.webp]

## Honor's mission is to change the way the world cares for its aging population.

For the first time in history, older adults out number the young, and caring for our aging loved
ones is one of society’s biggest challenges and opportunities. Together with Home Instead, we are
redefining care for older adults in communities around the world, leveraging technology, innovation,
and relationships to provide quality care – every time.

## Be the change

At Honor we inspire leadership at every level through a culture of collaboration, innovation and
challenging the norm. We relentlessly pursue excellence and we put our mission into action,
everyday. 

##### Together, we’re creating a new and better
##### aging experience for all.

**Designed for Long-Term Brand Value**

True differentiation goes beyond features or short-term trends.
We create **defensible product identities through engineering and materials**.
Positioning your brand for **sustainable, premium growth**.

[ Start Your Project ][133]

## Our Engineering Capabilities

At JCSPORTLINE, we provide complete carbon fiber solutions—from prototypes to mass production.Our
capabilities include prepreg carbon fiber (autoclave- or oven-cured), vacuum-infusion and RTM-molded
composites, and compression-molded or forged-carbon components—customized to your exact needs.Using
advanced processes such as autoclave curing, RTM, and vacuum infusion, we deliver strong, precise,
and high-quality parts. Whether for custom projects or large-scale production, we turn your ideas
into premium carbon fiber components.

[home-engineering-1]

### Concept Feasibility Development

### From ideas to engineering-ready solutions
* Concept sketches from designers
* Feasibility & Structural reports
* Composite material & Process selection
* Structural planning: Single/split molds
* Lead time: **3–7 days**

### [See our concept development services][134]

[Rapid carbon fiber prototyping]

### Rapid Carbon Fiber Prototyping

### Fast, accurate low-volume prototyping
* CNC tooling and 3D printed molds
* Autoclave prepreg prototype fabrication
* ±0.3 mm tolerance for functional parts
* Automotive, sports, and marine use
* Lead time: **7–15 days**

### [See our prototype capabilities][135]

[home-engineering-3]

### Small - Batch Production

### Flexible production for niche projects
* Production volume from **1–500 pcs**
* Prepreg autoclave, infusion, wet lay-up
* Cosmetic and structural carbon parts
* Matte, gloss, or clear coat finish
* Lead time: **5–20 days**

### [See our small-batch production][136]

[Mass production programs]

### Mass Production Programs

### Scalable manufacturing for volume orders
* Automated compression molding
* P20 steel molds with stable tooling
* ISO / IATF 16949 quality control
* Scalable lines in Hubei and Huizhou
* Lead time: **volume dependent**

### [See our mass production capabilities][137]

## Composite Manufacturing, Coordinated for Your Success

At JCSPORTLINE, our multiple factories specialize in different composite manufacturing processes,
ensuring the right solution for your project’s volume and technical requirements.
With a global engineering and sales team, we facilitate seamless communication between our overseas
R&D teams and China’s production teams, reducing communication costs and enhancing efficiency. This
close collaboration ensures your projects are delivered on time, no matter the scale.

### [Explore the Factory][138]

[home-Factory]

## Custom Carbon Fiber Products, Built with Specialized Facilities and Engineering Support

JCSPORTLINE connects carbon fiber material development, R&D, design support, autoclave and vacuum
infusion, compression molding, in-house weaving, and global engineering resources into one
integrated manufacturing system. From custom product concepts to prototypes, molds, small-batch
production, and scalable OEM/ODM delivery, our specialized facilities help B2B clients develop
reliable carbon fiber products with better process control, surface quality, structural performance,
and production flexibility.

Hubei – Autoclave & Vacuum Infusion Facility

Core Technologies:
• Autoclave prepreg molding
• Vacuum infusion

Best For:
• Automotive exterior components
• Water-sports products
• Applications requiring clear, high-definition carbon weave

Shenzhen HQ– Marketing & Design Center

Core Resources:
Marketing support and client management
Design collaboration and product customization
Car data scanning & reverse engineering
R&D product selection support

Best For:
Carbon fiber solutions for automotive, sports, and lifestyle
Supporting distributors with marketing and customer outreach
Assisting R&D with product design and selection

Dongguan – Compression Molding Factory
Core Technologies:
  • High-pressure compression molding
  • Forged carbon fabrication
Best For:
  • Sports equipment
  • 3C electronics & digital accessories
  • Aerospace components
  • Medical housings & lightweight structures
Shenzhen – Carbon Fiber R&D Center
Core Focus:
  • Early-stage testing and validation
  • RTM, hot-press, compression molding pilot runs
  • Small-batch prototypes (1–50 pcs)
  • Cross-category carbon fiber innovation
Role in Your Project:
  • Complex composite structures are tested and validated here before mass production
  • Creates feasibility reports, structural testing, and process evaluations
In-House Carbon Fiber Weaving Factory

Core Capabilities
Custom woven patterns
Toray carbon fiber
In-house weaving control
Logo / texture customization

Best For
Auto / aero / sports
High-precision patterns
Unique branded designs

Global Design & Engineering Network
Global Support Network:
  • Worldwide teams support JCSPORTLINE China projects
NL Netherlands – EU Hub:
  • Design support, 3D scanning, warehousing
US Los Angeles – Engineering Center:
  • Aero engineering, 3D scanning, local support
CA Canada – Structural Center:
  • Structural analysis & prototype validation

## AI-Powered On-Time Delivery for Carbon Fiber Projects

JCSPORTLINE provides full AI-powered transparency for carbon fiber projects and orders—so customers
can track every stage in real time.

**1. On-Time Project Delivery**
AI shows clear, step-by-step project progress—from design to sampling—ensuring predictable
timelines.

**2. On-Time Order Delivery**
Every order milestone is visible in real time, covering production, quality checks, packing, and
shipment.

[ Request a Demo ][139]

## 58-Day Concept-to-Sample: Fast, Precise, Reliable

We transform your ideas into reality in just 58 days. From initial concept to sample, our process
ensures fast, efficient delivery with exceptional quality. Starting with a detailed feasibility
report, we move through requirements analysis, engineering design, prototype manufacturing, and
testing. Every stage is carefully managed to meet your deadlines and deliver the best results.

### [Read More][140]

## Centralized Standards for Consistent Quality

At JCSPORTLINE, we believe that quality is built through design and manufacturing, not just
inspection. Every carbon fiber part we create for you begins with a detailed feasibility analysis,
structural simulation, and controlled design inputs to eliminate risks before production even
starts. We ensure that your project is set up for success from the very beginning.

[ISO Certification]

### ISO Certification

Our carbon fiber production follows ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 certified quality systems, ensuring
traceable, documented processes from raw materials to final inspection.

### [Explore Our Quality Workflow ][141]

[Carbon Fiber Structure Drawing]

### Quality by Design

Every project begins with feasibility analysis and engineering validation—ensuring quality is built
into the design, not discovered during production.

### [Explore Our Design Standards ][142]

[Carbon Fiber Quality Inspection]

### Consistent Production

Standardized processes and controlled production parameters guarantee consistent quality across
prototypes, small batches, and full mass production.

### [Explore Our Quality Standards][143]

## Who We Are

**Your Engineering Partner for Advanced Composites**

We bridge the gap between **innovative design** and **manufacturable reality**.
Our mission is t

## Our Engineering Capabilities

At JCSPORTLINE, we provide complete carbon fiber solutions—from prototypes to mass production.Our
capabilities include prepreg carbon fiber (autoclave- or oven-cured), vacuum-infusion and RTM-molded
composites, and compression-molded or forged-carbon components—customized to your exact needs.Using
advanced processes such as autoclave curing, RTM, and vacuum infusion, we deliver strong, precise,
and high-quality parts. Whether for custom projects or large-scale production, we turn your ideas
into premium carbon fiber components.

[home-engineering-1]

### Concept Feasibility Development

### From ideas to engineering-ready solutions
* Concept sketches from designers
* Feasibility & Structural reports
* Composite material & Process selection
* Structural planning: Single/split molds
* Lead time: **3–7 days**

### [See our concept development services][134]

[Rapid carbon fiber prototyping]

### Rapid Carbon Fiber Prototyping

### Fast, accurate low-volume prototyping
* CNC tooling and 3D printed molds
* Autoclave prepreg prototype fabrication
* ±0.3 mm tolerance for functional parts
* Automotive, sports, and marine use
* Lead time: **7–15 days**

### [See our prototype capabilities][135]

[home-engineering-3]

### Small - Batch Production

### Flexible production for niche projects
* Production volume from **1–500 pcs**
* Prepreg autoclave, infusion, wet lay-up
* Cosmetic and structural carbon parts
* Matte, gloss, or clear coat finish
* Lead time: **5–20 days**

### [See our small-batch production][136]

[Mass production programs]

### Mass Production Programs

### Scalable manufacturing for volume orders
* Automated compression molding
* P20 steel molds with stable tooling
* ISO / IATF 16949 quality control
* Scalable lines in Hubei and Huizhou
* Lead time: **volume dependent**

### [See our mass production capabilities][137]

## Composite Manufacturing, Coordinated for Your Success

At JCSPORTLINE, our multiple factories specialize in different composite manufacturing processes,
ensuring the right solution for your project’s volume and technical requirements.
With a global engineering and sales team, we facilitate seamless communication between our overseas
R&D teams and China’s production teams, reducing communication costs and enhancing efficiency. This
close collaboration ensures your projects are delivered on time, no matter the scale.

### [Explore the Factory][138]

[home-Factory]

## Custom Carbon Fiber Products, Built with Specialized Facilities and Engineering Support

JCSPORTLINE connects carbon fiber material development, R&D, design support, autoclave and vacuum
infusion, compression molding, in-house weaving, and global engineering resources into one
integrated manufacturing system. From custom product concepts to prototypes, molds, small-batch
production, and scalable OEM/ODM delivery, our specialized facilities help B2B clients develop
reliable carbon fiber products with better process control, surface quality, structural performance,
and production flexibility.

Hubei – Autoclave & Vacuum Infusion Facility

Core Technologies:
• Autoclave prepreg molding
• Vacuum infusion

Best For:
• Automotive exterior components
• Water-sports products
• Applications requiring clear, high-definition carbon weave

Shenzhen HQ– Marketing & Design Center

Core Resources:
Marketing support and client management
Design collaboration and product customization
Car data scanning & reverse engineering
R&D product selection support

Best For:
Carbon fiber solutions for automotive, sports, and lifestyle
Supporting distributors with marketing and customer outreach
Assisting R&D with product design and selection

Dongguan – Compression Molding Factory
Core Technologies:
  • High-pressure compression molding
  • Forged carbon fabrication
Best For:
  • Sports equipment
  • 3C electronics & digital accessories
  • Aerospace components
  • Medical housings & lightweight structures
Shenzhen – Carbon Fiber R&D Center
Core Focus:
  • Early-stage testing and validation
  • RTM, hot-press, compression molding pilot runs
  • Small-batch prototypes (1–50 pcs)
  • Cross-category carbon fiber innovation
Role in Your Project:
  • Complex composite structures are tested and validated here before mass production
  • Creates feasibility reports, structural testing, and process evaluations
In-House Carbon Fiber Weaving Factory

Core Capabilities
Custom woven patterns

In-house weaving control
Logo / texture customization

Best For
Auto / aero / sports
High-precision patterns
Unique branded designs

Global Design & Engineering Network

  • Aero engineering, 3D scanning, local support

# Driving
# Sustainable Growth
# Across the Aging Industry

Elevating Senior Health with Scalable Strategies.
LBIngenuity is a strategic marketing consultancy for the longevity market.
[ Let’s Talk Aging ][21]

##### *As Featured In:
##### *

[idea-primary]

#### Fractional Marketing

LBIngenuity serves as a Fractional Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) for organizations in the longevity
market. This executive-level engagement provides strategic oversight of brand positioning, growth
planning, and market analysis. Designed for flexibility, the model supports startups and scale-ups
seeking senior-level marketing leadership without the commitment of a full-time hire.

[award-primary]

#### Strategic Growth Partner

Acting as a strategic growth partner for aging-related companies, LBIngenuity defines sustainable
growth strategies individualized for each organization. This solution supports both emerging and
established teams, offering structured advisement, annual planning, and team-specific coaching to
drive performance.

[team-primary]

#### Growth Training Programs

LBIngenuity delivers growth-focused training for marketing professionals at every level, ranging
from new hires to senior leadership. These virtual or in-person programs are designed to support
both individual organizations, corporations or franchise systems, integrating proven strategies into
daily operations to power performance across the aging industry.

## Our Core Competencies

LBIngenuity is a senior care thought leader, recognized as a marketing expert who helps build
valuable relationships with potential clients and partners across the industry's diverse segments.

# Smarter Care, Without Cameras

Motions supports elderly independence, pet well-being, and family peace of mind.

Know More

## Meet Motions.

At home, it’s the little daily movements that tell the bigger story. Knowing when a fridge is
opened, when someone gets into bed, or when a pet eats can bring comfort and peace of mind. Motions
turns these everyday actions into simple insights, helping families stay connected without cameras
or intrusion.

[Know More][10]

## Motions stands for

### **Discreet, Smart Technology**

Compact sensors that track daily life — without cameras or intrusion.

### Peace of Mind Through Insights

Every movement is captured, so families never miss what matters.

### **Supporting**
### ** independence**

Helping older adults and pets live safely while keeping families connected.

## **Why Choose Motions?**

### **Live in safety without worries**

Motions quietly monitors everyday movements 24/7 and instantly shares insights when something
changes. Traditional monitoring systems miss up to 80% of daily activities because they rely on
cameras or devices people forget to use.

### **Peace of mind for everyone**

Over 60% of elderly routines — like meals, rest, or nightly movements — go unnoticed, leaving
families uncertain about their loved one’s well-being. Motions makes the invisible visible,
detecting activity patterns and unusual changes in real time.

### **Care made simpler for everyone**

Motions supports caregivers and family members by providing clear, accessible activity data. Its
intuitive dashboard reduces guesswork, helps identify risks earlier, and enables more personalized,
proactive care.

### **100% privacy protection**

Motions never uses cameras or microphones. Only discreet motion data is collected, analyzed
securely, and shared as insights. Families and caregivers receive peace of mind without compromising
dignity or privacy.

80%

**of daily household activities — like meals, sleep, and movement, go untracked with traditional
monitoring systems.**

65%

**of families only discover changes in routine days or weeks after they happen.**

100%

## **See Life in Motions.**

Our discreet sensors track daily routines like meals, sleep, and movement,
giving families and caregivers peace of mind in real time.

#### **Who It’s For**

**Elderly Care** – Know if your parent rolled into bed safely or is up at night.
**Pet Owners** – Track when your dog or cat eats, moves, or rests.
**Home Awareness** – Keep track of daily activities without intrusive monitoring.

*→ **Expolre Our Official Website ***

[[Motions Living Insights]][19]

Motions is a smart activity monitoring system designed for families, caregivers, and pet owners. Our
discreet sensors track everyday movements, like meals, sleep, and routines and deliver real-time
insights without cameras or intrusion. With Motions, you gain peace of mind while your loved ones
live independently and safely.

## Why NMSC?

##### Accurate market positionings

01

Identify your competitive advantage with our comprehensive and detailed market positioning services.
We work with you to create a customer-centric strategy that will help you succeed in the
marketplace.

##### Market estimates & forecasts

02

Receive accurate estimates and forecasts for your industry with our expert analysis. We offer a
range of services, including opportunity analysis, competitive landscape assessments, and market
position studies.

##### Validation and data assurance checks

03

We have a process in place to run periodic checks on our data models to determine correlations
between macroeconomic datasets and our sourced market data to ensure maximum accuracy.

##### Profound data sources

04

We take our data sources seriously. Our data sources are deep-rooted, reliable, accurate, and
well-regarded, which include paid databases, primary research, statistical organizations, government
agencies, and industry intelligence providers, among others.

##### Industry analysis with clarity

05

Our market taxonomy allows you to work smarter by aligning your revenues with relevant market
metrics. We allow you to step back from tactical tasks of monitoring the markets - so you can
resurface from below the waterline.

##### N.E.X.T. insights

06

For a deeper dive into a niche sector, we present market financial information that is complete,
accurate, and verifiable through what we call N.E.X.T. Insights - so you can trust what you see.

## Comprehensive and accessible care services for the whole family

Building on more than four decades of experience and expertise, NTUC Health is among the largest
senior day care, nursing home and home personal care providers in Singapore.

We also offer other services for seniors such as fitness classes and senior gyms, and community
support for vulnerable seniors. In addition, we run a family medicine clinic.

[home-elderly-care.jpg]

Enjoy peace of mind when you entrust us with the care of your loved ones. We provide different care
services from centre-based and home care, to temporary respite care and 24/7 residential care.
